items.author: Trump
items.text: I have paused the 50% Tariffs against Canada, that were scheduled to kick in tomorrow morning for a three day period, based on the fact that Canada and the U.S.A., subject to the finalization of documents, have a DEAL! The great Keystone XL Pipeline, long ago killed by Sleepy Joe Biden, may be awoken from the grave! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣布暂停对加拿大50%关税三天，因美加达成框架协议，Keystone XL管道可能重启——关税和能源基础设施双重利好。

items.text: In April, I signed a very important Executive Order to accelerate medical treatments for serious mental illness — Specifically, psychedelic drugs, including IBOGAINE. items.author: Trump
items.text: RT @realDonaldTrumpThe Senate must vote on the NO MORE CHANGING THE CLOCKS ACT as soon as possible. More sun later in the day is better (including for fighting crime!), but, even more importantly, NO MORE RIDICULOUSLY CHANGING CLOCKS AND WATCHES TWICE YEARLY, with all of the disruption and chaos it causes. FINALLY, GET IT DONE!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump 喊话参议院尽快通过《不再调整时钟法案》，主张全年夏令时——民生议题，无直接市场影响。
